    t.ultimate_parent_description,
    t.ultimate_parent_unique_id AS naics_code,
    t.ultimate_parent_description AS naics_description

    t.ultimate_parent_description,
    t.ultimate_parent_unique_id,

    t.ultimate_parent_description
ORDER BY
